title: The courtyard
about: A personal world painted on ELYND's production server on 2 Nov 2026 for our own test note (no real listener's). Only fields that hold nothing of the meditation: the painting, SAM 3.1's region map, the step times, the cost (cost_usd is both bills, Meta's Model API and Muse Spark Open's host; open_usd is part of it), the judge's score, the models and Llama 3.3's place description (the same step re-run on the same meditation: production keeps no copy of it).

place.text: A courtyard in late afternoon, warm golden light, with a red watering can, an old olive tree, and a dog asleep in its shade.

clock: the agent's own: from its start, after the meditation was written
